body_html:
JAMMIN’ Trivia hosted every Tuesday night at 9pm  to 11pm in beautiful Loveland Georgia. Despite the frigid temperatures and the icy road conditions, they are no match for the dedicated rivalry of the Loveland Applebee’s JAMMIN’ Trivia teams. The big win went to Team Old School with a captivating ending score of 126 points. Followed closely by Team BuckFobama who finished 2nd with 114 points for the night.  Sister +1 came in 3rd place to end the champions of the evening! Be sure to bring your friends and you A-Game if you want to battle wits! For the best entertainment in northern Georgia get JAMMIN” Trivia to host a night of fun and entertainment!

~Steve~
